summary: John's 4th-great-grand-uncle; transported to New South Wales after the 1834 Ballynonty constable killing.
bio: Baptized 1812, son of Humphrey Heffernan and Anastasia Ryan. With his brother Patrick and others he was convicted of manslaughter over the killing of 'Constable Feeney' at Ballynonty in 1834, and transported to New South Wales for seven years.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
